messages:
elaine: Quick check — DevConnect booth run-of-show draft is linked https://tinyurl.com/devconnect-runbook. Need final swag counts, speaker AV test slots, and inbound lead routing. Can someone take lead routing? Also confirm if promo postcards arrived.
sam: I can own lead routing. I'll set up the Typeform -> HubSpot flow and a QR short link. Will post mapping in the sheet by EOD.
neha: Packing list updated. Swag on hand: T-shirts 120, stickers 400, promo cards 500, stress-balls 100. Will top up T-shirts to 150 if we approve.
rafa: Speaker run-throughs — can do Tue 2pm & Wed 9am. Which speakers? @tasha @sam?
tasha: I can do Tue 2pm. I'll be onsite for mic check.
orders-bot: Order #ORD-9921 confirmed — 50 extra t-shirts shipped, eta 2 days. Tracking: https://courier.co/track/ORD-9921
ops-bot: Venue A/V report uploaded to runbook, note: mic 2 has intermittent hiss, onsite tech confirmed they'll bring backup lav.
sam: For lead routing: prefer form -> hubspot list 'devconnect-2026' + auto-email 'thanks@redwood.ai' + tag 'event:devconnect'. Will set up capture QR and short link.
neha: Can we switch 25 of stickers to die-cut? Cost +$40 ok?
elaine: Approved. Please update PO and confirm delivery.
neha: Done — PO updated and emailed finance.
rafa: Also submitted talk materials for the panel — slides uploaded to runbook under /speaker-deck.
elaine: Awesome. Last thing: swag desk volunteer schedule — @sam can you confirm headcount for shifts?
sam: Yep — I'll post shift roster by EOD with volunteers and backup contacts.
elaine: Great, thanks everyone. We'll do final walk-through Fri 10:30am. :thumbsup:
